words.ex: The head teacher praised our class for collecting so many warm clothes for the children's home.
Her first novel was highly praised by readers and teachers alike, and it has already been translated into twelve languages.
Nodira plays the rubab so brilliantly that the whole hall falls silent the moment she starts.
The hospital in our town has first-rate surgeons, so patients come from other regions for operations.
The new sports centre has top-notch equipment: the treadmills even show you a film of running through the mountains.
Our new class monitor is really on the ball: she spotted the mistake in the timetable before any of the teachers did.
Uncle Rustam has a way with animals: even the noisiest dog in the mahalla calms down when he talks to it.
Our biology teacher has green fingers: tomatoes, roses and even lemons grow beautifully in the little greenhouse behind the school.
Anvar could sell sand in the desert: he's got the gift of the gab and never runs out of things to say.
My sister's handwriting is miles better than mine; teachers can actually read hers.
Our school's robotics club is streets ahead of the others in the region; it has won the competition three years running.
Bekzod is among the best chess players in our school, though he still loses to his little sister sometimes.
The apricot jam from that small farm in the Fergana Valley was out of this world; we finished the whole jar in two days.
The food critic criticised the new restaurant for its tiny portions and painfully slow service.
The newspaper article was very critical of the new car park, saying it had destroyed a lovely old garden.
Before the long hike across the hills, the guide reminded us that carrying enough water was critically important.
Newspaper reviewers loved the young director's first film; it was critically acclaimed and won prizes at three international festivals.
After the motorway crash, the lorry driver was critically ill in hospital for a week, but he has now made a full recovery.
Javohir is always running down his old school, but secretly he misses his teachers there.
However carefully I plan our class trip, Doniyor always manages to pick holes in it.
Wearing a winter coat in the middle of a Bukhara summer? What an absurd idea!
The referee decided that both players were at fault and showed each of them a yellow card.
Don't look at me! I'm not to blame for the missing scissors; I gave them back to Komila yesterday.
Since he got the lead role in the school play, Jamshid thinks he's the cat's whiskers and hardly talks to the rest of us.
Ever since her dance video got a thousand views, Gulnora thinks she's the bee's knees.
When it comes to remembering birthdays, my uncle is the world's worst; one year he even forgot his own.
Plenty of people whisper during films, but answering a phone call in the middle of the cinema really takes the biscuit!

words.en: have your cake and eat it
words.ex: Timur wants to skip every team practice and still play in every match; he wants to have his cake and eat it.
words.gap: have his cake and eat it

have her cake and eat it
have their cake and eat it

words.ex: The coach accepted the criticism calmly and promised to change the team's tactics.
In our photography club, members bring their latest pictures and criticise each other's work honestly.
Getting enough sleep the night before an exam is critical to doing well.
Her first novel won critical acclaim and has been translated into twelve languages.
After falling from the scaffolding, the worker was taken to hospital in a critical condition.
